title: Are You Brave Enough? Matt Rife's Haunted Warren Museum Opens in Salem
excerpt: Comedian Matt Rife officially brought Ed and Lorraine Warren's iconic paranormal collection to Salem. Tour 14 spooky rooms filled with over 1,000 real haunted items.
content:
The Haunted Warren Museum in Salem, Massachusetts is officially open, just in time for the spooky season. The haunted attraction offers self-guided flashlight tours of 14 different rooms. According to the museum's website, the house is well lit to enjoy the space without the use of flashlights, they are "solely there to enhance your experience."

From Connecticut to Salem: Matt Rife Expands the Warren Collection

Comedian Matt Rife purchased the former Connecticut home of Ed and Lorraine Warren back in 2025 and relocated many of the haunted items to the Salem location in the summer of 2026.

Now, the Haunted Warren Museum has become "significantly bigger and more terrifying than I think any of us really anticipated," Rife said.

READ MORE: The Insane Price Matt Rife Charges For a Stay in His Haunted House

Hours, Tickets, and Flashlight Tour Details

"This museum is an extension of Ed and Lorraine Warren's work over the last 70 years and we have collected over 1000 of the world's most haunted objects and items added them to Warrens' already historic collection," Rife said. The property is open seven days a week with tickets available through Sunday, November 8, 2026.

1,000+ Haunted Artifacts: From Annabelle to True Crime Relics

"You can come learn as much as you want about the paranormal, possession, demonology, voodoo, vampires, murder mystery and more," Rife said. Items in the collection include the original Annabelle doll, pieces from the Amityville haunting and the Conjuring house, spirit communication devices, serial killer artifacts, witchcraft collections, artifacts from ancient civilizations, true crime items, sacred relics, as well as never-before-publicly displayed pieces from around the world.

"Have fun," Rife said.

Luxury Redefined: Take a Tour of this $12 Million Home in North Salem

So, you’ve got a cool $12 million lying around and are in the market for a mansion that makes Buckingham Palace look like a starter home? Well, have we got a place for you! Located at 123 Dream Lane, North Salem, NY, this breathtaking estate spans a massive 83 acres and is a stunning replica of the English Georgian masterpiece “Salutation.” With 10,700 square feet of pure luxury, this home is designed to impress at every turn. As you explore, you’ll find expansive grounds perfect for outdoor activities, a serene English garden, top-notch equestrian facilities, and luxurious indoor amenities like a spa-like indoor pool and a state-of-the-art gym. Each room is crafted for comfort and sophistication, from the grand entrance with its dramatic staircase to the cozy library and elegant dining spaces. Get ready to step into a world where luxury meets tranquility—let’s take a closer look inside this $12 million mega-estate!
